note: FICTIONAL test data. Deliberate edge cases and the handling we expect. Use in tests; never show as real data.

edge_cases.description: Five tenants all request each other but W-STD-2 holds 4 per apartment (assumed capacity, likely 2 per bedroom).
edge_cases.expected_handling: Cannot place all five together; flag to review queue, keep requests, do not silently split without explanation.

edge_cases.description: Mutual roommate request, but one tenant has an animal and the other has an animal-allergy restriction.
edge_cases.expected_handling: Must not share an apartment; flag the request with the reason.

edge_cases.description: Request text 'Quinn Jelyberry' is a misspelling of 'Quinn Jellyberry' (FAKE-00009); the reverse request is spelled correctly.
edge_cases.expected_handling: Suggest the likely match for staff confirmation; keep the original wording; do not auto-resolve without confidence.

edge_cases.description: Requests 'Rowan Glimmerpatch', who has no tenant record.
edge_cases.expected_handling: Unresolved; review queue with original wording.

edge_cases.description: First tenant requests the second; the second made no request.
edge_cases.expected_handling: Valid but weaker; attempt if it does not hurt others; show as non-mutual.

edge_cases.description: Request just says 'Jordan'; two tenants with first name Jordan share that floor plan.
edge_cases.expected_handling: Ambiguous; do not guess; review queue lists both candidates.

edge_cases.description: A women's-plan tenant requests a men's-plan tenant by full name.
edge_cases.expected_handling: Ineligible to share; exclude with reason, keep in review queue.

edge_cases.description: Mutual request, but the two tenants contracted different floor plans.
edge_cases.expected_handling: Cannot share without a contract change; flag, do not change contracts automatically.

edge_cases.description: Two renewing tenants live in 3616 and both want to stay.
edge_cases.expected_handling: Prefer keeping both in their current apartment.

edge_cases.description: Renewing tenant in 5793 wants to move.
edge_cases.expected_handling: Move to a different apartment of the same plan, preferring the same building and floor, then an adjacent floor.

edge_cases.description: Renewing tenant lives in 7679 (M-STD-3) and wants to stay, but contracted M-FLAT-4.
edge_cases.expected_handling: Staying is impossible under the contract; flag and propose M-FLAT-4 apartments on the same building floor (then adjacent floors) apartments.

edge_cases.description: Staff-confirmed required_floor=1; manager pre-placed and locked in 5793.
edge_cases.expected_handling: Preserve the lock; any move must be refused with the restriction shown.

edge_cases.description: Renewal stay in 5955, already locked by a manager.
Second tenant requests the first, but staff confirmed they must not share an apartment.
edge_cases.expected_handling: Restriction wins; request excluded with reason.

edge_cases.description: M-OTH-4: 10 contracts but only 1 apartment(s) x 8 = 8 places.
edge_cases.expected_handling: Some tenants cannot be placed; report shortfall honestly, never exceed capacity or move them to another plan silently.

edge_cases.description: Apartment 1375 has capacity_override=5 (W-STD-3 assumed plan capacity 6).
edge_cases.expected_handling: Validation must use the override, not the plan capacity.
